notes.title: The Quench Artbook is now available with 50% launch discount!
notes.content:
[h2]Explore Quench: the beautiful eco-conscious puzzle sim for the whole family[/h2]

[h3]ON SALE NOW for +50% OFF![/h3]

We've added some special DLC items for Quench, just in time for the Steam Winter Sale:

[list]
[*] [b]RELEASED TODAY! [/b][i]The World of Quench: Art Book & Guide[/i] is 60+ pages packed full of tips, tricks, lore and concept art from the making of Quench. Learn how to best use your powers to your advantage, get a full walkthrough of each level, and revisit the art and story of the game including nine original pieces made by artists from around the world. 

[*] The Quench OST follows Shepherd and Shaman's grand pilgrimage as they meet new friends and restore the world on their way to the Eastern Elder Tree. Composed by Adam Sakiyama with additional music by Robby Duguay. 

[*] [b]A NEW SPECIAL EDITION BUNDLE which includes Quench, Digital Art Book AND OST is OVER 60% OFF![/b]
[/list]

[h3]The Steam Winter Sale is on for a limited time; it’s the perfect chance to gift this award-winning game to family or friends, or explore the world of Quench for yourself![/h3]

Get [i]The Woirld of Quench: Artbook & Guide[/i]: 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1489180/Quench_Art_Book__Guide/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1489180/Quench_Art_Book__Guide/[/url]

Get the Official OST: 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175110/Quench_Official_Soundtrack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175110/Quench_Official_Soundtrack/[/url]

Get the Quench Special Edition Bundle: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18241/Quench_Special_Edition/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18241/Quench_Special_Edition/[/url]

notes.title: Patch notes for version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Clearer path selection glyphs on mouse and keyboard (Z and X for next and previous paths instead of arrow keys, which move the camera)
[*] Added context glyph hint for moving the camera during weather placement mode
[*] Fixed an issue with inconsistent controller detection in How To Play overlays
[/list]

[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] Volume now lowers to 20% when the game is paused
[*] Game volume is muted while application is minimized
[/list]

[b]Gameplay/Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the credits
[*] Hid/disabled the cursor in scenes that don't require it if inactive for 3s
[*] Fixed an issue with firefly traps in levels 15 and 24
[*] Fixed an issue with player inappropriately losing the competition in level 13
[/list]

[b]Upcoming changes (not in this version)[/b]
[list]
[*] Adding player options for remapping, vsync, camera speed, assist modes
[*] General performance improvements
[/list]

Did you find a bug or want to request a feature? Head over to our Discord #support channel to report it! --> [url=http://discord.io/quench-support]http://discord.io/quench-support[/url]
